findings.title: robots.txt blocks all AI retrieval bots
findings.root_cause: robots.txt contains blanket disallow directives for primary AI retrieval searchbots, preventing page ingestion.
findings.evidence: robots.txt contains 'User-agent: GPTBot\nDisallow: /' and 'User-agent: ClaudeBot\nDisallow: /'. Both ChatGPT Search and Claude Search are explicitly excluded from crawling any page.

suggested_action.summary: Remove or scope the GPTBot and ClaudeBot Disallow rules to allow AI retrieval of public marketing content.
suggested_action.technical_fix: Edit /robots.txt. Replace 'Disallow: /' for GPTBot and ClaudeBot with 'Disallow:' (empty, allow all) or scope to private paths only (e.g. 'Disallow: /account/').
suggested_action.creative_fix: No content changes needed — this is a pure technical access fix.
suggested_action.verification: Re-fetch https://example-brand.com/robots.txt and confirm GPTBot and ClaudeBot directives allow /.

findings.title: No Organization schema on homepage or About page
findings.root_cause: Absence of machine-readable Schema.org Organization declarations leaves entity identity ambiguous to generative engines.
findings.evidence: Crawled 12 pages. No JSON-LD with @type Organization, LocalBusiness, or Corporation found on any page. The homepage title tag reads 'Example Brand — Enterprise Solutions' but no machine-readable identity declaration exists.

suggested_action.summary: Add Organization JSON-LD to the homepage and About page.
suggested_action.creative_fix: No body-copy changes required — schema is a head-level signal.
suggested_action.verification: Run Google Rich Results Test on https://example-brand.com and confirm Organization entity is parsed.

findings.title: Founding year contradicts across pages
findings.root_cause: Inconsistent editorial facts across first-party pages degrade factual consensus in LLM knowledge representation.
findings.evidence: About page states 'Founded in 2012'. Homepage footer states 'Serving customers since 2015'. Three-year discrepancy creates hallucination risk in LLM synthesis.

suggested_action.summary: Reconcile and standardize the founding year across all pages to the correct value.
suggested_action.technical_fix: Update whichever page is incorrect. Add foundingDate to Organization schema once resolved.
suggested_action.creative_fix: Verify the correct year via company registration records and update copy on both pages consistently.
suggested_action.verification: Re-crawl both pages and confirm a single consistent founding year appears in all contexts.

findings.title: Product pages lack causal explanatory depth
findings.root_cause: Content emphasizes superficial feature lists without explaining underlying causal mechanisms ('how' and 'why').
findings.evidence: 5 of 6 product pages scored depth_score < 2. Causal conjunctions (because, therefore, enables, results in) appear fewer than 2 times per page. Average word count: 220 words. Pages rely on bullet-point feature lists without mechanistic explanation.

suggested_action.summary: Expand product page body copy to explain the causal mechanisms behind key product capabilities.
suggested_action.technical_fix: Incorporate FAQ structured schema explaining product value propositions.
suggested_action.creative_fix: For each product page, add 80-120 words explaining how the core feature works mechanistically. Example pattern: 'Feature X works because [mechanism], which enables [outcome], resulting in [measurable benefit].'
suggested_action.verification: Re-run geo-content sensor; confirm depth_score >= 3 on all product pages.

findings.title: No sameAs identity links to external authority sources
findings.root_cause: Missing external sameAs links deprives the brand of external knowledge graph corroboration from authoritative registries.
findings.evidence: Organization schema present but sameAs array is absent. No Wikidata, Wikipedia, LinkedIn, or Crunchbase identity links declared.

suggested_action.summary: Add sameAs links to verified external identity sources in the Organization schema.
suggested_action.creative_fix: No content changes. Ensure LinkedIn company page and any Wikipedia/Wikidata entries are accurate and up to date before linking.
suggested_action.verification: Re-crawl homepage; confirm sameAs array resolves cleanly in Google Rich Results Test.

proactive_actions.title: Add FAQ schema to top 3 product pages
proactive_actions.summary: Adding FAQPage JSON-LD with 40-80 word answers to the top 3 product pages is projected to increase Google AI Overview citation eligibility based on Princeton KDD 2024 evidence-genre research.
proactive_actions.technical_fix: Inject FAQPage JSON-LD snippet containing primary customer questions and answers.
proactive_actions.creative_fix: Author direct 40-80 word answers following the BLUF (Bottom Line Up Front) pattern.
proactive_actions.verification: Test with Google Rich Results Test to verify FAQ rich result eligibility.

proactive_actions.title: Add visible last-updated dates to all article pages
proactive_actions.summary: 7 article pages lack visible publication or modification dates. Pages with explicit recency signals are cited more frequently in generative AI search results.
proactive_actions.technical_fix: Add <time itemprop='dateModified' datetime='YYYY-MM-DD'> to article headers.
proactive_actions.creative_fix: Include visible 'Last updated on [Date]' byline next to author credentials.
proactive_actions.verification: Confirm dateModified appears in parsed Article schema.

proactive_actions.title: Add statistical evidence to homepage value proposition
proactive_actions.summary: Homepage makes qualitative claims ('industry-leading', 'best-in-class') without quantitative support. Adding 2-3 concrete benchmark metrics will improve citability.
proactive_actions.technical_fix: Mark up statistics with DataFeed or ClaimReview schema where appropriate.
proactive_actions.creative_fix: Replace vague claims with verified metrics: '99.99% uptime SLA' and '< 12ms P95 latency'.
proactive_actions.verification: Confirm numerical density rises above 2.5% in text statistics sensor.
